sections.content: With “I”, an *-ik* verb does not take *-ok/-ek/-ök*. It takes *-om*, *-em* or *-öm*: *dolgozom*, *reggelizem*. After back vowels it is *-om*, after front vowels *-em* (or *-öm* after *ö* or *ü*). You already use this pattern in *lakom*.

sections.title: Compare
sections.content: Regular verbs keep their usual ending: *főzök*, *olvasok*. Only the “I” and “he/she” forms of an *-ik* verb are different.

items.english: I have breakfast in the morning.
I do not work on Mondays.

sections.content: *Dolgozok* is the usual mistake. A verb with *-ik* in the dictionary says “I” with *-om/-em/-öm*, so *dolgozom*. Check the dictionary form first.
